text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. Many debugging tools can help you with this task, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution in your code editor. However, a systematic approach is often more effective than guessing. Start by checking small parts of your code one at a time. Also, logging is very useful because it records what your program is doing while it runs. With patience and good methods, you can solve most bugs successfully.
